items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: James Mundy on tenor sax, Cecil Irwin on tenor sax

ctx.x: You have George Dixon -- in the brass section we had George Dixon, Charlie Allen, Walter Fuller, and we had so many other trumpet players, man, I can't think of all of them.

Wait a minute, I'm trying -- I'm thinking about the band after we started broadcasting. After we got, you know, made all the changes. Got tight and everything, and started broadcasting. In the trombone section we had Louis Taylor and William Franklin. William Franklin sang and played trombone. In the saxophone section, as I say, we had Darnell Howard, Omer Simeon on lead sax, James Mundy on tenor sax, Cecil Irwin on tenor sax, and I think that was it

in the saxophone section.
George Dixon doubled trumpet and saxophone, baritone sax. So sometimes we had five saxes.
